caption.text:
Dalam sebuah video, terekam momen pilu ketika seorang anak perantau akhirnya pulang ke kampung halaman. Namun, ia tidak sempat bertemu dengan sang ibu untuk terakhir kalinya. 

Sebelumnya, sang ibu diketahui tengah berjuang melawan penyakit dan selalu menantikan kepulangan anaknya. Sayangnya, jarak dan keterbatasan keadaan membuat pertemuan tersebut terus tertunda.

#Okezone #viral #momenharu #anakrantau
caption.text_translation:
In a video, capture the painful moment when a nomadic child finally returns to his hometown. However, he didn't get to see his mother for the last time.

Previously, the mother was known to be battling illness and was always waiting for her child to return. Unfortunately, distance and limitations of circumstances made the meeting delayed.

 #Okezone #viral #momenharu #anakrantau
